caseName: Olley v. Philadelphia & Reading Coal & Iron Co.
caseNameFull: Olley v. Philadelphia & Reading Coal & Iron Co.
attorneys: Mr. Vincent A. Carroll for petitioners. Mr. Penrose Hertzler for respondents.

opinions.text:
The motion to dispense with the printing of the record is granted. The petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals' for the Third Circuit is denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.
